generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per e-portal
The tender is of two cover system.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in Tender Schedule-B (Financial Bid) in the website itself
For those tenderers whose Technical bids satisfy the eligibility criteria and who has furnished all the necessary documents, only their financial Bids will be opened
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/documents furnished by the tenderer should the circumstances so warrant. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect/false or invalid then the EMD furnished by such tenderer shall be forfeited
Right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons rests with the accepting authority
The successful bidders shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act
The contractor shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers working in this area

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all applicable taxes), levies, duties and Cess, building worker welfare Cess (if applicable) etc., as per the latest GOK and Government of India prevailing as on the date of NIT
The rates uploaded in the e procurement portal are exclusive of GST and GST will be paid separately
The Bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rates as issued by the PF Department from time to time

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and submit the Material Dispatch Permit (MDP) receipt, if not submitted penalty shall be charged as per the joint secretary, Energy Department letter no. Energy26 PPT 2022 dtd:26.04.2022
KPCL shall recover the Income tax etc., at the prevailing applicable rates

The successful bidder should strictly adhere & ensure the minimum wages Act to the labours prevailing as per the Govt. rules & regulations. The bidder should maintain register of labour deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority and remittance towards PF shall commensurate with the labour component for the work involved
Contractor should have independents PF Code. The Contractor shall remit PF of labourers to contractors permanent PF code Number only and Not to the KPCL PF Sub Code
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day shall be reckoned
If the contractor makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Further details of the work can be obtained in the office of the Executive Engineer (PCM-1), KPCL, RTPS, Shaktinagar - 584170, during office hours
The tender Notification along with Blank Tender Form will be accessible in the e-procurement website (www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in).

Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID and Password for participating in e-procurement in Karnataka Power Corporation Limited may now obtain the same from the website www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only
In case the agency fails to execute the work properly, engineer may entrust the work to the other agency at the cost and risk of original agency
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the Last date of submission of bid
All labourers Police verification is to be carried out by the contractor & same to be submitted for gate passes and cost is also to be borne by the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute the complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval competent authority.

Contract Performance Guarantee: The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG), for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract value with an appropriate validity period (i.e. Validity period is the Contract period and including work performance guarantee period) shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of first and final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final bill of the successful bidder. The work Performance shall be of Twelve (12) Months after completing the work. The total contract period is 17 Months (i.e. 05 Months completion period & 12 Months Guarantee performance period). The Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) will be released only after the satisfactory completion of total contract.
The bidder shall belong to CAT-II(A) as per Govt. of Karnataka. Valid CAT-II(A) certificate issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be uploaded.
The bidder shall be a domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years certified by Govt. of Karnataka. Valid Domicile certificate issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work Experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (At least 90% of the Contract value) as a prime contractor at least one civil construction work of value not less than Rs. 21.25 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) in the last Five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the Technical bid. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27).

The intending bidder should have executed the works involving Reinforced/Plain Cement Concrete of quantity not less than 205.30 cum in any one of the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the technical bid.

The intending bidder should have executed the works involving Steel reinforcement of quantity not less than 7.05 Tonne in any one of the preceding five completed financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the Competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the technical bid.

Financial Turnover:The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in At least one financial year annual Financial Turnover of value not less than Rs.85.00 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST) during the last five completed financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). The bidder shall submit the certified copy of Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant for the respective year and the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid.(Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)

Providing and fixing of acid and alkali resistant tiles of 300 x 300 x 12mm size having minimum compressive strength 200kg/cm2 and MOH hardness of with water absorption of less than 0.3% with all lead and lifts following the below procedure: 1. Surface reparation: Cleaning all loose dust particles and aggregates with a wire brush or other mechanical tools. The surface, if required shall be washed soap water and then flushed with clean water to remove oil particles, grease, etc. 2. Specification for AR tiling: over the dry even concrete surfaces, apply 1 coat of VIKOSEAL-AR primer. Further over the dried primed surface, apply VIKOSEAL-AR bitumen mastic to a thickness of 6mm. Over the Bitumastic surface, fix A.R. tiles of size 300 x 300 x 12mm (conforming to IS- 4860 Class II) in the bedding of VIKOPROOF-SDK silicate cement (conforming to IS-4832 Part I). Rake open the joints to about 3-4 mm wide and 10mm deep. Fill in the joints with VIKOPROOF-EP Epoxy Resin Cement (conforming to IS-4832 Part II).

Rake open the joints to about 3-4 mm wide and 10mm deep. Fill in the joints with VIKOPROOF-EP Epoxy Resin Cement (conforming to IS-4832 Part II).
